identificationModule.briefTitle: A Phase II Study of GC101 in NSCLC
identificationModule.officialTitle: An Open-Label, Phase II Study to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy Using Autologous Tumor Infiltrating Lymphocytes Injection (GC101 TIL) in Patients With Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: 28 participants are expected to be enrolled for the Phase II clinical trial, this trial is expected to be finished in 36 months.

armGroups.label: GC101 TIL
armGroups.description: Participants with advanced NSCLC using cryopreserved GC101 TIL

interventions.name: Autologous Tumor Infiltrating Lymphocytes
interventions.description: A tumor sample is resected from each participant and cultured ex vivo to generate tumor infiltrating lymphocytes. After lymphodepletion, patients are infused GC101 TIL followed low-dose PD-1 antibody.

primaryOutcomes.description: Proportion of subjects in total cases in complete or partial response (RECIST v1.1 criteria)
Evaluate the efficacy endpoints of PFS by the investigator with RECIST

secondaryOutcomes.description: Evaluate the efficacy endpoints of DCR by the investigator with RECIST v1.1 and iRECIST
Evaluate the efficacy endpoints of DOR by the investigator with RECIST v1.1 and iRECIST
Evaluate the efficacy endpoints of OS
Incidence of adverse events associated with GC101 TIL infusion
